description: Build ONE deduplicated list of everyone who RSVPed to / held a ticket for several of your events (e.g. every past dinner in a series) — give event_ids (from list_events) and a list_name (found or created). Same person across events counts once (by account, else email). Returns people, per-event counts, how many have an email, and how many you may email marketing (recorded permission or community email opt-in). Optional where: min_tickets (bought, e.g. 2 = "2 or more"), min_events_attended, checked_in_only, min_net_spend_cents + currency (USD default) — only people meeting every condition are kept; the result states the rule and counts (matched). Optional list_id pins a stable id for a new list so a campaign draft in the same plan can target it. dry_run counts without writing. Never records consent. Requires a connected account; you must host every event.
name: build_list_from_events
title: Build List From Events
